frontMatter.purpose:
This Employee Handbook provides an overview of Riya Groups, Human Resources policies and procedures.
As an employee of Riya Group, you are expected to abide by all the policies and Procedures presented in the Handbook. It is, therefore, in your best interest to read the Handbook and familiarize yourself completely with all of its contents.
Riya Group reserves the right to modify, interpret, revise, supplement, or rescind any policies or portions of this manual from time to time as it seems appropriate. Such revisions may be made at the sole discretion of Riya Group and may be made with or without prior notice. Employees are therefore requested to speak to HR for updated policies
We hope that this Handbook will be your first reference when any questions arise in your mind regarding Company policies. Should you have any questions concerning any of the information contained in the Handbook, or if you have specific questions not answered in the Handbook, please consult with your immediate supervisor or Department / Unit Head or the Human Resources Department.
This Handbook is meant strictly for internal use. The contents of the Handbook are general and solely intended as a guide. The language used and the information contained in this Handbook is supplementary to and will not override the terms of an employment contract between the Company and any of its employees.
Note - *This handbook is reviewed annually, but is subject to change at any time based on the necessity for update

chapters.title: Induction:
chapters.text:
An induction programme is held for the newly recruited employees to ensure that the new entrants are extended all information and guidance that are needed to get a good start and become familiar with their job role, work culture and service conditions. All new joinees are mandatorily required to attend the induction.
## Appointment:
Every employee at the time of appointment, confirmation, promotion, classification or reclassification, etc. is given a written order specifying the nature of his/her appointment, confirmation, promotion, classification, and stipulating other conditions of appointment, wherever necessary.
## STAFF DEVELOPMENT

chapters.title: Probation:
chapters.text:
Every employee recruited / appointed by the management should, unless otherwise specifically mentioned in the appointment order, or subject to the conditions stipulated in the order of appointment, be on probation for a period which would be 6 months’ maximum and further extension of One month on the probation period. Managers need to either confirm or part ways with the staff if no performance improvement is noticed in the staff as further extension of probation period is not allowed.
During the probationary period, the Management can dispense the services, for any reason whatsoever at any time, the Management has the right to do so without assigning any reason and without giving any notice, and the probationer will only be paid for the actual number of days worked based upon the rate of monthly salary mentioned above and will not be entitled to any payment in lieu of such notice or termination of employment.
During the period of probation, the probationer will not be entitled to any privilege and/ or benefits which are allowed to the company’s permanent staff.
On successful completion of probation, the reporting manager would review the performance of the probationer. would lead to confirmation whereas will result in partying ways with the staff. A Confirmation mail will be sent to the employee to confirm his/her services in the company

chapters.title: Training:
chapters.text:
Every employee recruited would undergo a general orientation about the company and specific training in the specialized area where they have to work. The training plan and duration would be developed according to the nature of the work and position. During the training the trainee would work under the guidance of the supervisor/senior and would obey the rules and regulations as well as the instructions from superiors.
Any refusal to participate in a training & development programme without any extraneous circumstances would lead to a strict action against, which may also include termination of services.

chapters.title: Transfer:
chapters.text:
Every employee is liable to be transferred at the discretion of the Management, from one department or branch to another, giving due consideration to his/her qualification / experience, competence etc. Employees are also liable to be transferred to any subsidiary of the company or any other establishment belonging to the company, whether at present existing or that may be established in the future or to any other company formed by splitting up or reorganizing the company.
Employees who are seeking transfer to another branch have to drop an email to his/her reporting manager with a copy to HR. Transfer request would only be considered/sanctioned if the respective branch has an opening which matches the employee grade, experience and competencies.

## IT POLICY
## Computers:
Each employee is responsible for maintenance of the computer he/she is using. They should follow the naming conventions for files/folders, take back up regularly and follow the safety instructions for virus protection. Unauthorized use of CD/USB/Hard disk and installation of unauthorized software are not permitted.
## EMail Usage Policy:
Company electronic communications systems must be used only for business activities. Users are forbidden from using Company electronic communication systems for private business activities, or amusement/ entertainment purposes. Limited use of Company resources for personal emergencies is permitted. All communications and information transmitted by, received from, passing through, or stored in these systems are company records and exclusive property of the company.
Users are reminded that Company electronic communications systems are not encrypted by default. If sensitive information must be sent by electronic communication systems, encryption or similar technologies to protect the data must be employed.
Company’s policies against sexual or other harassment apply fully to the electronic communication systems, and any violation of those policies is grounds for severe disciplinary action including termination. Therefore, no messages should be created, sent, forwarded, or received on any of the electronic communication systems if they contain intimidating, hostile, or offensive material concerning sex, race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or any other classification protected by law. Additionally, under no circumstances may Company computers or other electronic equipment be used to obtain, view, or reach any pornographic, or otherwise immoral, unethical, or non-business-related Internet sites. Doing so can lead to disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.
## Computer Viruses:
Users are not authorized to turn off or disable virus detection software. Antivirus software detects changes in configuration files, system software files, application software files, and other system resources. Integrity checking software must be continuously enabled or run daily. User possession or development of viruses or other malicious software is prohibited.
If Users get virus alerts, they must immediately disconnect from all networks and cease use of the affected computer, and then call the IT Team for technical assistance.
## Password Policy:
All user-chosen passwords must contain at least one character from three of the following groups: capital letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and punctuation marks. All passwords must be promptly changed if they are suspected of being disclosed, or known to have been disclosed to unauthorized parties.
Users are responsible for all activities performed with their personal user-IDs. User-IDs may not be utilized by anyone but the individuals to whom they have been issued. Users must not allow others to perform any activity with their user-IDs. Similarly, Users are forbidden from performing any activity with IDs belonging to other users.
## Internet Usage:
All the social networking sites (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn etc.) have been blocked by the IT team, but there are employees who are still accessing them from their mobile devices. It is strongly advised to refrain from using social networking during working hours.

chapters.title: Performance Management System:
chapters.text:
All confirmed employees will be appraised based on their performance at least once in a year. He / She will be given the opportunity to explain their contribution towards the organization and their ability to take more responsibilities.
## Annual Increment:
All the confirmed employees are eligible for an annual increment. You cannot claim any increment as a matter of right. This will be at the sole and absolute discretion of the Management and will be based on your performance.

chapters.title: Fire Safety:
chapters.text:
Fire presents significant risk to the Company. It can kill or seriously injure employees or visitors and can damage or
destroy buildings, equipment and stock. As an employee you must cooperate with the Company to ensure the workplace is safe from fire and its effects. You must inform your manager if you discover any significant risk of fire which might affect the safety of others and co-operate with all measures to reduce/control the risks. You should ensure you know about the fire warning system and how to operate and respond to it.
## The following simple points will help to reduce the risk from Fire:
- Escape routes must be free from any obstructions.
- Good standards of housekeeping.
- Keep workplaces tidy.
- Regularly remove any combustible waste.
- Keep ignition sources away from combustible material.
- Switch off your system before leaving.
## Refreshment Rooms:
- A sufficient number of toilets and urinals are provided in the premises for both male and female staff.
- Apart from the housekeeping staff, it is also the duty of the employees using it to maintain its cleanliness.
- Any complaints regarding Refreshment rooms should be escalated to the Admin. Department.
## Gift Policy:
Company prohibits offering, giving, soliciting or receiving any form of bribe or anything conditioned upon granting or receiving an individual or business benefit or an official action.
## Category of permissible gifts includes:
- Gifts given as courtesy
- Gifts given as an expression of Gratitude
- Gifts given for the demonstration or promotion.
- Gifts are customary and do not violate any local law of the land
## Legal Disputes:
If you are involved with a lawsuit or other legal dispute between the Company and another entity or person, you should not discuss it with either outsiders or other Riya Group employees without the prior approval of your manager and the Legal Department.
## Misconduct and Disciplinary Action:
Employees are not supposed to disclose by word of mouth or otherwise, particulars or details of business plans /trade secrets /finance /administration and / or any other information in relation to the business of the Company, coming to your knowledge by virtue of your being in the employment of the Company.
Riya Group follows a Model standing order under section 5 (3) of the Industrial Employment (Standing Order) Act, 1946. Any employee found breaching any of the policies mentioned in employee handbook/Appointment letter or the Model standing order under section 5 (3) of the Industrial Employment (Standing Order) Act, 1946 can be issued a disciplinary action form/ Memo. Receiving 3 such Memo will lead to termination of service. Employees involved in misconduct can also lead to termination on immediate grounds. Few of them are mentioned below:
The following acts and omissions on the part of a workman/employee shall amount to misconduct. Gross misconduct will result in the initiation of Company disciplinary procedure, and may result in immediate dismissal with or without notice or pay in lieu of notice.
- Throughout the continuance of your service as a Riya Group employee, you are required to devote all of your work hours exclusively to your assigned duties with the Company. While serving Riya Group Company, you shall not, without prior consent in writing from the Management, engage yourself directly or indirectly, with or without remuneration, in any other trade, business, occupation, Part time / Full time honorary or remunerative employment or service. Such an engagement can be considered as grounds for termination of service with Riya Group.
- Willful insubordination or disobedience, whether or not in combination with another of any lawful and reasonable order of a superior.
- Going on an illegal strike or abetting, inciting, instigating or acting in furtherance thereof;
- Willful slowing down in performance of work, or abatement or instigation thereof; or interference with the work of another workman.
- Theft, Fraud or Dishonesty in connection with the employer’s business or property or the theft of property of another workman within the premises of the establishment;
- Taking or giving bribes, any illegal gratification, receiving or accepting for own benefit any commission, rebate, discount, gift or profit of any nature from any person, company or firm having business transactions with the Company.
- Habitual absence, Unauthorized absence or absence without permission from duty for more than seven (7) Consecutive days will be dealt seriously and lead to a severe action which can be termination of your services, at the sole discretion of the Management. In such a case, you will not be entitled to any Notice or payment of salary in lieu.
- Collection without the permission of the Manager of any money within the premises of the establishment except as sanctioned by any Law for the time being in force;
- Engaging in any trade or business within the premises of the establishment;

chapters.title: Work From Home Policy
chapters.text:
## Overview
Work from Home (hereinafter referred to as “WFH”) is the model of working from a virtual location, either on a full time or part time basis. The WFH policies appended within shall come into effect for the employee of Riya Travel & Tours (hereinafter referred to as “Company”)
## Objective
- To provide the ease of working from home to employees of the Company, where such an arrangement is required without affecting the business and their daily productivity.
- To upkeep business continuity at the company level and save time & boost productivity at the individual level.
- To ensure full compliance to the Company’s WFH policy by the employee.
## Applicability
- Employees will be permitted for WFH based on the criteria of the nature of the job.
- Employees shall be required to complete two months’ tenure in the Company.
- If an employee is hindered to travel to work owing to any personal exigency, parenting, transportation & bad weather issues, but is deemed fit and healthy to undertake his/her duties from home.
- Employee who does not require constant face to face interaction with client/s.
- Employees must possess the Company laptop/desktop to be eligible for WFH.
- The Head of Department along with HR shall assess the eligibility for working from home.
- Employees who have resigned and are serving notice period shall not be eligible to WFH and will need to begin operating from office premises during the notice period.
## Rules
- The eligible employee participating in the WFH model must sign the Company’s WFH Agreement and Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA).
- The reporting manager shall formally assess the effectiveness of WFH model for the employee and submit the report in the Company specified form. This will ensure there is no unfavorable impact on business operations and internal & external stakeholders.
- The employee eligible for the WFH model shall demonstrate integrity and adherence to the signed NDA by not divulging any business information whatsoever, either intentionally or unintentionally to a third party.
- Employee roles & responsibilities, KRAs, KPIs, core business working hours, specified break hours, project goals/timelines, business etiquettes. established by the Company and the reporting manager remains unchanged during the temporary work from home arrangement.
- Employees shall update the attendance in the employee portal by mentioning the reason Work from home approved by the HOD.
- Employees are required to be always available for emergency unscheduled meetings, calls or ad-hoc tasks called out by the reporting manager during the core business working hours at all times via phone, email, google hangout or any other electronic platform specified by the Company.
- Employees are required to attend all meetings, training, conferences held in the office, through teleconferencing or in person, as applicable.
- Employees are required to immediately notify the reporting manager in the event of any recurring technical issues until its resolution.
- Employees should not conduct business meetings with their team, peers or business associates at home. Such meetings need to be scheduled in the office premises with prior intimation to the reporting manager and by complying with Company’s policy for occupying the conference room. The employee will not be assigned a permanent workstation in the office.
- In the event the employee is required to visit a client or other location/s for business purposes, the mileage can be claimed from the employee’s home base as per Company’s mileage policy.
- Employees shall ensure that the home office is conducive, safe, noise free and devoid of hazards for effective discharge of official duties, managing the Company equipment.
- The Company shall not be liable for the loss, mishaps or destruction to the employee’s residence or injury to inhabitants that may occur within or in the vicinity of the employee’s home.
- The Company shall not reimburse the cost incurred towards (i) making any structural change to an employee’s home office & (ii) recurring utility bills (electricity), for any other cost kindly refer to clause 5(b).
- In the event of ad-hoc WFH requirements arising due to personal exigencies, bad weather & transport issues the employee must obtain prior approval of the reporting manager.
- The Company reserves the right to make onsite visits with prior notice to the employee’s home office for the purpose of inspecting, monitoring or retrieving company owned equipment.
- Should the employee move to a different position during the employment term, the WFH agreement shall be rendered null and void. The employee will be required to submit a fresh application based on the new role.
- The WFH facility extended to the employee shall be periodically reviewed by the reporting manager. The Company reserves the right to withdraw the WFH facility, in the event of any abuse, intentional or unintentional by the employee.
…

chapters.title: Provident Fund:
chapters.text:
Each and every employee has to join the P.F. scheme and the deductions will be as per the P.F. Act. The company also will contribute its share towards P.F. i.e. 12% of employee’s gross salary or 12% of 15,000/- whichever is lower. This will be an additional saving for the employees’ future. An employee can also increase his/her PF contribution by sending a mail to the HR department, whereas the employer’s contribution would be fixed to the PF limit of Rs. 15,000/-. Any employee who has been transferred from one branch/unit to another has to fill up the PF transfer form which is available with the HR department. Employees can also opt for voluntary PF, an email needs to be sent to the HR team, in this case VPF would be deducted from employee’s salary and the employer contribution towards PF would not increase.
## E.S.I.C. Contribution:
- Employees State Insurance Corporation provides medical facilities by the employer as per ESIC Act.
- The main objective of this insurance scheme is to provide medical relief and sickness benefits to all members and maternity benefits to all female employees through a contributory fund.
- The E.S.I. Corporation provides every employee covered under this scheme an Identity Card. By registering with ESIC the employee and his/her family members are entitled to receive medical benefits at an ESIC designated hospital or clinic.
- The ESIC deduction is compulsory for all employees drawing a salary up to Rs.21, 000/-and is registered under this Act.
## Annual Additional Benefit:
A specific amount is disbursed by the company every year as additional benefit. This has been a practice which has been followed for many years now and it has been disbursed irrespective of company’s performance. Please be informed that disbursement of this benefit to resigned staff is at the sole discretion
of the Management and not of the employee. This cannot be claimed as a right by any resigned staff.
For existing staff, this is a “Discretionary” which shall be given every year and is a part of the employee's CTC structure. To know more please contact the HR Department.
The Gratuity Scheme is covered under Riya Travels Employees Group Gratuity Assurance Scheme with LIC. Gratuity is applicable only to those employees who complete 5 years of continuous service with the company. For Further Details, contact the HR Department.
## Maternity Benefit:
Maternity leave is entitled for pregnant women for 182 days immediately following the day of her delivery or her miscarriage. Maternity Benefit is applicable only for Confirmed female staff. Staff covered under ESIC need to claim Maternity Pay from the ESIC office. For More details, contact the HR department.
You must give The Company at least 4 weeks' notice in writing of your intention to take maternity leave combined with a medical certificate concerning the expected week of the birth of the baby. If you wish to take additional maternity leave, this must be intimated to the HR department and your reporting here at least 4 weeks prior to the end of maternity leave. Maternity extension would be given at the sole discretion of the management keeping the work profile in mind.
The Company reserves the right to refuse payment for time-off to employees where there is an abuse of this procedure, and any such abuses will be dealt with under the Disciplinary Procedure.
## Leave Encashment and Carry Forward*:
Every confirmed employee is entitled for 24 calendar days of Privilege Leave in a year, where the leaves are calculated on a pro-rata basis post confirmation. There is No leave encashment or leave carry forward so you may opt to use all your PLs. For Further Details, contact the HR Department.
Employees who are drawing salaries more than 21, 000/- are entitled for 2,00,000/- Insurance Coverage with Care Health Insurance Pvt Ltd.. New Joinee can avail cashless benefit post completion of 20 days in the company. Employees on contract / external consultant / Contract workers / Staffs on sabbatical are not eligible for Mediclaim. For Further details, contact the HR Dept.
## Allowances:
## Expense Reimbursement Process:
We have now taken a new step and it is towards digitization of our Expense Reimbursement from Offline (Paper & Pen) to Online mode and making the entire Expense Reimbursement process paperless.
All the reimbursement claim needs to be done on the Riya Intranet App. To avail your reimbursement, firstly you need to download Riya Intranet App from Google Play Store. You will find a tab as ‘Reimburse’ in the Riya Intranet App. Below are the steps that you need to follow to claim all types of reimbursement (Local conveyance, Sales Visit etc.) as per your profile.
- Go to the tab ‘Reimburse’ where you need to login with your employee code.
- The same will be validated with an OTP which will be sent to your mobile number mentioned in HR records. In case, if there is any change in the mobile number, kindly get in touch with the HR Team to update the same.

chapters.title: Notice Period:
chapters.text:
- Below is the Notice Period clause, the appointment can be terminated at any time by either party giving the Notice mentioned in the clause in writing or payment of salary in lieu thereof would be at the discretion of the Management.
[table]
| Notice Period @ Designations / Grades | During Probation & Post Confirmation |
| Sr. No. | Designations | Grades | Revised Notice Period |
| 1 | CXO - General Manager | G2 - G4/L1 | 90 |
| 2 | Deputy General Manager - Manager | G4/L2 - G6/L1 | 60 |
| 3 | Deputy Manager & Below (till Office / Admin Assistant) | G6/L2 - G10 | 30 |
- Software and Designing team post confirmation has to serve a notice period of 90 days and 30 days during probation. Payment in lieu of notice period would be at the discretion of the Management.
## Procedure:
- Employees resigning need to mail their Managers about their decision of resignation.
- Post resignation of the employee, the reporting manager would inform HR along with the final relieving date.
- The employee has to fill in the clearance form which is available in the employee portal. Lack of submission will lead to delay and/or stoppage on processing the settlement.
- In case of resignation; the salary would be put on hold for the month on which the resignation is applied. Also additional days of PLs will be deducted from his/her Full & Final Settlement. At the same time if there is any surplus leave balance; then the same cannot be encashed during Full & Final Settlement.
- Any leaves availed by staff during the Notice Period would be considered as leave without pay and balance leaves cannot be adjusted against the Notice Period.
- Payroll will process the full & final settlement within 45 days from the date of leaving. Staff error /dues would be deducted from the employee’s salary at the time of disbursing full & final settlement.
- For any waiver of the service of notice period or adjustment of the same by reducing against payment of notice period shortfall, an approval from the Vertical Head and HR Head would be required.
- A relieving letter will be issued to the employee only after the Full and Final is completed. Whereas we would not be issuing relieving cum experience Letters to employees who are resigning and are still under probation. Similarly, any employee who is terminated would not be issued an experience cum relieving letter even on demand.
- Gratuity would not be released for staff who do not complete their notice period/exit formalities.

chapters.title: ​Retirement Policy: ​
chapters.text:
As per rules of the Company, the ​ retirement age is 60 years. On account of superannuation he/she shall be eligible for all the​ ​benefits/funds/payments as applicable under law. ​ ​​If the Company recognizes the need to retain certain
exceptional, highly skilled and productive staff beyond the normal age of retirement it may do so for a period of up to Five years. ​
## Amendment*
The management has the right to make changes to the above policy in future for whatsoever reasons. However, any changes or amendments in the policy would be communicated to all employees.
